study type: Meta-analysis of case-control and cohort studies
exposure: advanced maternal age at subsequent pregnancy
increased BMI prior to the subsequent pregnancy
elevated 1-hour plasma glucose levels in oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) during previous pregnancy
increased 2-hour OGTT glucose levels in previous pregnancy
cohort: The study included 11,385 women with a history of GDM during re-pregnancy, comprising 2,462 patients who experienced recurrent GDM and 2,909 who did not.
finding: Advanced maternal age, elevated BMI before subsequent pregnancy, increased OGTT levels during the previous pregnancy, and the delivery of macrosomia are significant risk factors for recurrent GDM.
